title: Garage Door Job Work Order Form
subtitle: Control inspection, stored-energy control, repair, balance, safety testing, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete garage door service job work order for doors, tracks, springs, cables, operators, controls, and safety devices. It connects manufacturer information and approved safety scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified garage-door service technician must control authorized garage door service work from arrival and baseline findings through change approval, service evidence, testing, and handoff.

sections.guidance: Anchor authorization, assigned work, materials, evidence, testing, and handoff to one controlled job record.

sections.title: Garage Door arrival, site readiness, and controlled work setup
sections.guidance: Verify actual site conditions before beginning and stop when dispatch assumptions no longer hold.

blocks.label: Site, access, exposure, and work-zone controls
items: Door, operator, remotes, and controls isolated against unexpected movement
Torsion, extension, counterbalance, and suspended-door energy controlled
People, pets, vehicles, and property cleared from the door path
Door weight supported before spring, cable, roller, track, or bracket work
Ladder, lift, tool, winding-bar, and access method appropriate and inspected
Structural attachments, header, track supports, and fasteners assessed
Photoelectric, edge, force, reversal, release, and control functions preserved
Replacement spring, cable, roller, hardware, and operator compatibility verified
Customer remotes and access features controlled during testing
Full balance and entrapment-protection test plan completed before release

blocks.label: Pre-work hazard and stop-condition review

Door cannot be independently supported during work

Photoelectric, edge, force, reversal, or emergency-release protection fails
Door is unbalanced, binds, drifts, falls, or requires excessive manual force
Operator, wiring, grounding, control, or power condition is unsafe
People, pets, vehicles, or property cannot be kept clear of the travel path
Replacement component compatibility or manufacturer procedure is uncertain

sections.title: Garage Door job work order closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This garage door service job work order is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when spring, cable, door support, operator, entrapment protection, balance, structural attachment, electrical, or controlled-energy condition is uncertain. A garage-door safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
